name: iylotus
description: IY Lotus design system: tokens, styles and components. Growth, beauty, discipline and wisdom.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @iylotus/tokens && npm run build -w @iylotus/styles && npm run build -w @iylotus/react && npm run build -w @iylotus/figma-plugin
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test -w @iylotus/tokens && npm test -w @iylotus/react && npm test -w @iylotus/figma-plugin
scripts.storybook: npm run build -w @iylotus/tokens && npm run build -w @iylotus/styles && npm run storybook -w @iylotus/react
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w site
scripts.build:site: npm run build && npm run build -w site
